data.name: Nabhanyu
data.gender_notes: Nabhanyu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Nabha’ (navel) and ‘Anyu’ (new). This name symbolizes a new beginning, a fresh start, and a young one. The name Nabhanyu carries the meaning “Newborn, Young One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nabhanyu usually hope their child will grow to embody newborn, young one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the connection between the divine and the physical world, as the navel is considered the center of the human body.
data.etymology: Nabhanyu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Newborn, Young One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabhanyu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nabhanyu could be a symbol of renewal or rebirth in Hindu culture, as it contains the word for navel, which is often associated with the concept of origin and the cycle of life. It could be given to a child at the start of a new year or after a significant life event, indicating the hope for a new chapter in their life. Additionally, the naarasimha avatar of Lord Vishnu is known as Nabhahaasura Mardhana, which means slayer of the demon Nabhahaasu,Adding richness and legacy to the meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the navel is considered to be the center of the body, connecting us to the earth and the cosmos. The name Nabhanyu can be seen as a reminder of our connection to the divine and the universe. It can represent the idea of spiritual renewal and the potential for growth and transformation within oneself. The name can be a call to focus on inner strength and resilience, allowing us to overcome challenges and kickstart new journeys in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nabhanyu: The radiant one, who resides in the navel center, igniting the spiritual fire within.

vedic_reference.note: Nabhanyu is not a Vedic name.

historical_references.reference: In Mahabharata, Nabhanyu is mentioned as the father of Bhishma. He was a descendant of the lunar dynasty and ruled the kingdom of Hastinapura as the king before Bhishma.

Another reference to Nabhanyu is found in the Puranas. He is described as the son of King Hidimba Vasistha and Hidimbi, a Rakshasi. This makes him the grand-father of Bhima, the Pandava hero in the Mahabharata.
